mapper.insert: insert ignore into nad_article_like (article_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{articleId}, #{userId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from nad_article_like where article_id = #{articleId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from nad_article_like where article_id = #{articleId}
select exists (select 1 from nad_article_like where article_id = #{articleId} and user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: insert ignore into nad_article_comment_like (comment_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{commentId}, #{userId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from nad_article_comment_like where comment_id = #{commentId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from nad_article_comment_like where comment_id = #{commentId}
select l.comment_id from nad_article_comment_like l join nad_article_comment c on c.id = l.comment_id where c.article_id = #{articleId} and l.user_id = #{userId} order by l.comment_id
